title: Indian Standard Specification / Test Method (IS IS_10531)
clause_1_scope: 1,1 This standard lays down the code of practice for selection and use of fire-resistant hydraulic fluids used for various applications, such as mining industry, steel plants., aluminium smelters, foundries, die-casting, plastic processing industries, etc.

clause_2_normative_references.title: Tests for fire resistant characteristics of hydraulic fluids used in mining machinery

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
